notes: Rectangles in the flowchart = normal packaging: either 'as_is' (package exactly as written in the BOQ) or 'split' into the listed work packages.
Ovals/circles = special cases (exceptions). They are expressed in 'special_rules' and always need user approval before they are applied.
Edit this file to change packaging behaviour; the agent's system prompt is generated from it.

Division options: 'only_specials' / 'exclude_specials' limit which ovals can apply inside that division; 'groups' + a category's 'group' give the parent boxes (Hardscape / Softscape); 'misc' names the package for items of a split division that match no listed package.

misc.definition: any other landscape / hardscape item (stone or granite paving, kerbs, site furniture such as benches, play equipment, car stoppers, barriers, shades, irrigation …)

WOOD_DOORS.definition: Wooden doors of any type (solid/flush/panel, MDF/HDF skin, beech زان, موسكي, سويدي) including frames (حلق/حلوق), architraves and ironmongery when part of the door item.

METAL_DOORS.definition: Steel / sheet-metal (صاج) / iron doors, fire-rated doors, security doors, steel gates, rolling shutters (شتر/ساتر).

ALUMINIUM_DOORS_WINDOWS.definition: Aluminium (ألوميتال / ألومنيوم) or uPVC doors and windows, sliding/casement systems, curtain walls, glazed facades, skylights, shop fronts.

HANDRAIL_STEEL.definition: Handrails, balustrades and guard rails made of steel, stainless steel, wrought iron or sheet metal (صاج / حديد / استانلس / مواسير).

HANDRAIL_WOOD.definition: Handrails / balustrades whose main material is wood (خشب).

HANDRAIL_ALUMINIUM.definition: Handrails / balustrades whose main material is aluminium (ألومنيوم / ألوميتال).

GLASS_HANDRAIL.definition: Glass balustrades / glass handrails (glass panels, possibly with metal posts or caps).

ACCESS_HATCH.definition: Access hatches, roof hatches, inspection / pit / manhole covers and plates (أغطية، فتحات كشف، لوح حديد مجلفن لتغطية).

SHIP_LADDER.definition: Metal ship ladders / cat ladders / vertical steel access ladders (سلم بحاري).

PLASTER.definition: Cement plastering / rendering of walls and ceilings (بياض، محارة، طرطشة، بطانة، ضهارة، لياسة).

EPOXY_PAINT.definition: Epoxy paints / epoxy floor coatings / self-levelling epoxy (إيبوكسي).

INTERNAL_STONE.definition: Marble (رخام), granite (جرانيت) or any natural stone (حجر) for INTERNAL floors, walls, stairs, sills, thresholds, skirting — internal finishes only.

ACRYLIC_PAINT.definition: Acrylic / plastic (بلاستيك) / emulsion paints, internal or external, incl. acrylic waterproof and textured paints (جوتن، سايبس، باديكو).

WOOD_FLOOR_CEILING.definition: Wooden flooring (باركيه، HDF/laminate flooring, deck) and/or wooden ceilings / wood ceiling cladding.

SUSPENDED_CEILING.definition: Suspended / false ceilings, gypsum board (جبسون بورد) ceilings and partitions, ceiling tiles, metal ceilings.

CERAMIC_PORCELAIN.definition: Ceramic or porcelain tiles for floors and/or walls, including skirting (وزر).

LS_INTERLOCK.definition: Precast concrete interlock paving blocks / pavers of any colour, pattern or thickness, incl. precast concrete stepping stones and landing slabs (وحدات رصف خرسانية سابقة التجهيز).

LS_DAKSHUM.definition: Base / sub-base layers of crushed limestone (دقشوم، كسر الحجر الجيري) under paving.

LS_CRUSHED_GRAVEL.definition: Crushed or loose gravel / pebbles / aggregate surfacing as a landscape finish (زلط، حصى، Aggregate Surfacing).

LS_CAST_IN_SITU.definition: Landscape concrete poured on site as a finished surface: cast-in-situ / exposed-aggregate / stamped concrete paving (رصف خرساني مصبوب في الموقع، خرسانة مكشوفة).

LS_FOUNTAINS.definition: Fountains, pools and water features and EVERYTHING built for them: their concrete, waterproofing / membranes, mosaic and stone finishes, copings, nozzles, pumps, lights and equipment (نوافير، حمامات سباحة، water wall). Not their excavation (that is earthwork).

LS_TARTAN.definition: Tartan / rubber (SBR, EPDM) athletic and playground surfacing and their rubber edging (أرضيات ترتان مطاطية، أرضيات الملاعب).

LS_MOBILIZATION_FURNITURE.definition: Furniture for site mobilization: caravans, temporary site offices and their furniture and equipment (أعمال الفرش، كرفانات، مكاتب الموقع المؤقتة). NOT benches or play equipment in the landscape.

LS_PLANTING.definition: Planting works: trees, palms, shrubs, ground covers, grass / turf, seeding, agricultural soil, fertiliser and soil improvement for planting (أعمال الزراعة، أشجار، نخيل، شجيرات، نجيل، تربة زراعية).

EXTERNAL_MARBLE.definition: Marble, granite or stone used OUTSIDE the building: facade cladding, external copings, external sills/steps, external wall stone (رخام / جرانيت / حجر للواجهات الخارجية).

ROOF_TILES.definition: Tiles / pavers laid as the finishing layer of ROOFS and terraces — cement tiles (بلاطات أسمنتية), ceramic/porcelain or terrazzo tiles on the roof (أرضية السطح) incl. their roof skirting — and pitched-roof tiles (قرميد).

EARTHWORK.definition: Earthwork found OUTSIDE the earthwork section: excavation (حفر), backfilling (ردم), soil replacement (إحلال) and compaction (دمك) — for foundations, pits, pump rooms, fountains or landscape. Not concrete, paving or planting that merely includes them.

EXPANSION_JOINTS.definition: Expansion / movement / settlement / seismic joints and joint covers (فواصل تمدد، فواصل هبوط).

WOOD_LOUVERS.definition: Louvers / sun breakers made of real wood (NOT aluminium with wood texture).

METAL_LOUVERS.definition: Louvers / sun breakers made of metal: aluminium (even with wood-texture finish), steel or sheet metal.

landscape_detection.note: A BOQ section is treated as LANDSCAPE (Div 32, split into the Hardscape / Softscape packages) when its title or sheet name says so, or when it uses landscape section codes. 'الموقع العام' on its own is NOT a signal yet (to be decided).

variants.note: General rule: the same product in different sizes, dimensions, thicknesses, colours, patterns or codes is ONE work package. Items are grouped when they share a parent description, share an item-code family (PC.01 … PC.08), or read the same once sizes, numbers and codes are removed. Every item of a group gets the group's category.

context_rules.note: Anything under an external-cladding heading always counts as EXTERNAL (e.g. granite skirting under 'التكسية الخارجية بالحجر' is external stone, not internal). The context is the item's headings and a short title-like parent, never the item's own text. Items of another special case (roof tiles, expansion joints, louvers) keep their own oval.

Every landscape item built for a fountain goes to Fountains: its own text or its description names a fountain / water feature (نافورة، نوافير، fountain, water wall, or a water-feature code WF-01 …). Applies inside Landscape only; fountain EXCAVATION stays earthwork (the Earthwork oval).
